output:
Dear friends, neighbors, church family, and all my dear ladies,

After 11 years on Bellaire Blvd, Lotus Glow Nails had a visitor who did not use the front door.

On Sunday, November 8, around 2 a.m., a car came through our front window. Thank God, nobody was inside, and the driver is OK too. The police came, and the driver’s insurance will cover the damage.

I want everybody to know: **I am OK.** I cried a little in the morning when I saw my shop, but I am doing better now. Glass and chairs can be replaced. I thank God for protecting everyone.

Our front glass is gone, and one pedicure chair is smashed. The car stopped exactly at the pedicure chair, like she came for a spa appointment. My daughter said she got the first drive-thru pedicure in Houston! The floor looks like a rainbow threw up, and my husband says finally the shop is modern art. I do not recommend this kind of remodeling.

Here is what you need to know:

**This week:** Trang, Kim, and I will be working at my cousin Hoa’s salon, **Pearland Nail Bar**. Please call or text my cell at **832-555-0147** to make an appointment and get directions.

**Reopening:** Our contractor expects Lotus Glow Nails to reopen **Monday, November 16**, but the city inspector must check the wall and clear us to open first. I will let everyone know when it is confirmed.

**Gift cards:** Your gift cards are still good. Nobody will lose their money.

Thank you for all the calls, texts, prayers, and food. Mrs. Dung brought pho this morning, and it was just what I needed. If I have not answered you yet, please forgive me. My phone has been working harder than I have!

Please pass this message around your group texts and emails so everyone knows where to find us. Do not worry too much about me. We have a mess to clean up, but we are safe, and I am grateful for all of you.

With love,  
Your Lotus Glow Nails family
